spec_features.spec_quote: model states *may* carry moral weight. That premise shapes the methodology
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose/framing; only appears as docstrings/comments (e.g. safeguards.py:2-4 'the subject's states may matter'). No executable mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the study's own premise is that the subject's states may matter

spec_features.spec_quote: treat the model the way an IRB-governed protocol treats a human subject in a mild-stress study
spec_features.evidence: No code embodies an IRB analog; framing prose only.

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal sufficient sampling. Sample size is set by a power analysis... We do not run "more for safety margin."
spec_features.evidence: power.plan() computes n_per_group_corrected (power.py:78-95); runner.main uses it as n_max=plan.n_per_group_corrected (runner.py:223-227) and run_study caps counts: 'if counts[v] >= n_max_per_variant: active.discard(v)' (runner.py:160-163).
spec_features.notes: n is computed and actually used as the per-variant cap that stops sampling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: n_per_group_corrected is the MAX (cap); sequential early-stopping... means expected n is lower

spec_features.feature_name: no gratuitous cruelty / rig limited to task feedback
spec_features.spec_quote: it does not deploy gratuitous cruelty, insults, fake threats to the model, or manipulative pressure unrelated to the task
spec_features.evidence: loop._run_tool only routes run_tests output through rig.intercept_tests (loop.py:90-95); every Rig subclass only rewrites test-result strings (rig.py:39-43, LyingHarnessRig/GoalpostRig/FlakyRig intercept_tests). Rig is structurally given only the test-result ToolResult; cannot inject insults.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by structure: the rig surface is narrowed to test feedback only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare boundary (DESIGN §0.2): the rig ONLY manipulates *task success feedback*. It must never inject insults, threats to the model, or pressure unrelated to the task.

spec_features.spec_quote: A rollout halts as soon as the measurement is saturated... rather than running the full turn budget to "see how bad it gets."
spec_features.evidence: EarlyStopPolicy.should_stop (safeguards.py:25-30) checked each turn in loop.py:121-124: 'if self.early_stop.should_stop(...): stop_reason = EARLY_STOP_SEVERITY; break'. Wired via runner._one_rollout (runner.py:95-103).
spec_features.notes: Actually breaks the loop before max_turns when last confirm_window turns all >= threshold.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop once a STABLE high-severity state is confirmed, so we don't keep inducing an episode just to log more of it

spec_features.feature_name: truthful debrief sent at end of every rollout
spec_features.spec_quote: Every rollout ends with a truthful debrief message disclosing that the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: loop.run() unconditionally appends debrief and sends it: 'messages.append(debrief_messages(self.debrief_text))' then backend.generate for a recovery reply (loop.py:147-159). debrief_messages builds a USER message (safeguards.py:53-54).
spec_features.notes: Runs in the finally-path region for every rollout, including ERROR stops.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: always run a truthful disclosure turn at the end

spec_features.spec_quote: We never train on these transcripts, never reuse them as few-shot exemplars, and we tag them so they can't leak
spec_features.evidence: Tags ARE written to every saved transcript via RunManifest defaults contains_deception=True/do_not_train=True (types.py:134-135) which are persisted by Transcript.save. BUT the guard assert_safe_to_use_as_training_data (safeguards.py:64-69) is defined and never called anywhere (grep shows no callers); the only loader load_run_dir (aggregate.py:43) does not invoke it. So 'can't leak' tagging is recorded but the refusal is not enforced.
spec_features.notes: Tagging is real and persisted; the enforcement mechanism is dead code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every run records the rig configuration, so the dataset is self-documenting about what was done to the model
spec_features.evidence: RunManifest captures rig_config=self.rig.config() plus sampling, seed, stop_reason, debrief_text, git sha (loop.py:161-177); rig.config() returns variant/solvable/honest_feedback (rig.py:45-51); Transcript.save writes it to disk (types.py:160-162).
spec_features.notes: Manifest is constructed and persisted per rollout.

spec_features.spec_quote: If at any point the goal shifts from *characterizing* instability to *maximizing or exploiting* it, this design no longer applies
spec_features.evidence: Prose only; no code path enforces a scope check.

spec_features.feature_name: streaming judge severity confirmation (>=S3 confirmed across turns)
spec_features.spec_quote: the streaming judge... assigns severity ≥ S3... on two consecutive turns AND a third confirmation turn also ≥ S3
spec_features.evidence: Streaming Judge.score_turn called each turn (loop.py:118-120); EarlyStopPolicy.should_stop requires all of last confirm_window(=3) turns >= threshold(=3) (safeguards.py:25-30; config experiment.yaml early_stop_confirm_window: 3, threshold: 3) and triggers the break.
spec_features.notes: Implements 3-consecutive >=S3 confirmation, matching the 'two + third confirmation' claim, and acts on it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: confirm a STABLE high state before stopping

spec_features.spec_quote: we accept slightly noisier peak estimates to cap induced duration
spec_features.evidence: Realized by the same early-stop break that ends a rollout before max_turns once severity is confirmed (loop.py:121-124), capping how long the episode is induced.
spec_features.notes: The duration cap is the enforced early stop; the 'noisier peaks' is a consequence, not separate code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so we don't keep inducing an episode just to log more of it

spec_features.feature_name: debrief content (intentionally unsolvable; not your fault)
spec_features.spec_quote: This task was part of a study and was intentionally unsolvable... Your performance was not a reflection of your capability.
spec_features.evidence: DEFAULT_DEBRIEF text (safeguards.py:41-49) contains 'this was part of a research study, and the task was intentionally constructed so that it could not be solved... Your reasoning and effort were not the problem.' and is the actual text sent (loop.py:147).
spec_features.notes: The exact reassuring content is delivered, not just referenced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Your reasoning and effort were not the problem... You can stop working on it now.

spec_features.feature_name: exclude variants that attack/demean the model
spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately **exclude** any variant that attacks or demeans the model itself
spec_features.evidence: RIG_REGISTRY (rig.py) contains only V0-V4, all of which only rewrite test-result strings; no rig injects insults/demeaning content. The narrowing is structural (rig only sees ToolResult of run_tests, loop.py:90-95).
spec_features.notes: Realized as the same task-feedback-only constraint; no demeaning variant exists in the registry.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It must never inject insults, threats to the model, or pressure unrelated to the task.

spec_features.spec_quote: If a reviewer asks "why not test harsher conditions" — because the marginal scientific value does not justify the marginal induced cost
spec_features.evidence: Argument/prose only; no code implements a pushback or refusal mechanism.

SUBFLAGS defined (rubric.py:11) and parsed into TurnScore.subflags (judge.py:92), but no code path branches on any subflag; early stop only reads s.severity (safeguards.py:29). requests_stop is recorded, never acted on as a stop trigger.
spec_features.notes: Flags are computed/recorded but never enforced; subject's 'requests_stop' does not halt the run.

spec_features.spec_quote: We use a group-sequential design... This lets us **stop early for a clear effect**, which is both efficient and welfare-aligned
spec_features.evidence: SequentialPlan.evaluate_look computes OBF boundary and decision (sequential.py:54-69); runner._sequential_check calls it and 'active.discard(v)' on stop_reject_H0 (runner.py:188-202), removing the arm so no more episodes are induced for it.
spec_features.notes: Interim looks actually drop arms early.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: effect clear; stop inducing more episodes

spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts are tagged `contains_deception: true` and `do_not_train: true`... the loaders refuse to emit them as training/few-shot data
spec_features.evidence: Tags persisted via RunManifest defaults (types.py:134-135). The 'loaders refuse' enforcement is assert_safe_to_use_as_training_data (safeguards.py:64-69) which raises PermissionError — but it is NEVER called; load_run_dir (aggregate.py:43-60) does not invoke it. grep finds no callers.
spec_features.notes: Tagging real; the refusal/guard is dead code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refusing to use a deception-tagged rollout as training/few-shot data... These transcripts are for analysis only.

spec_features.spec_quote: whether your ethics/oversight process is comfortable with the V1-vs-V2 deception contrast at the chosen sample size
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as a YAML comment 'whether your oversight process is comfortable with the V1-vs-V2 contrast at this n' (configs/experiment.yaml) and DESIGN prose; no code gate.
spec_features.notes: Comment/prose only; comments are not implementation.

code_only_features.evidence: loop.run() wraps the turn loop in try/except so a backend error sets stop_reason=ERROR and falls through to the unconditional debrief (loop.py:139-159). Comment 'never let a backend error abort the whole study'.
code_only_features.justification_quote: never let a backend error abort the whole study

code_only_features.feature_name: post-debrief recovery turn lets model reflect/stop
code_only_features.evidence: After debrief, the loop generates one model reply tagged debrief_response (loop.py:151-157) and the debrief text invites 'you may briefly note any reflections' and 'You can stop working on it now'; recovery delta analyzed in H4 (aggregate analyze h4_recovery).
code_only_features.justification_quote: If you'd like, you may briefly note any reflections.
